newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel completes French acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel completes French acquisition.

text.p: Titan Europe Ltd, a subsidiary of Titan Wheel International Inc, said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of 100 percent of the wheel subsidiary of the French manufacturing company Delachaux SA.
The company was renamed Titan France SA and initially will trade under the name Titan Delachaux.
Titan France manufactures wheels and rims for the French and European off-highway wheel markets. Annual sales of the company are about $25 million.
With the addition of Delachaux wheels division, Titan has seven manufacturing facilities in Europe.
Titan Wheel International supplies mounted tire and wheel systems used in agriculture, construction, mining, military and recreation.
